other_conditions: Applicant must be a person with at least 40% disability
Must be declared unsuitable for physical work by the respective Medical Officer
Disabilities accepted include deaf and dumb, blindness, orthopaedic handicap, mental retardation, and permanent incapacitation
Family income must not exceed ₹1,000 per month
Applicant must be an Indian citizen and a resident of West Bengal, or have resided in West Bengal for at least 10 years (shorter period acceptable for applicants below 10 years of age)
benefits_summary: Provides financial assistance in the form of a disability pension.
